text:
God Wars Dungeon 1 (Normal Mode)

​
Disclaimer
⬥ IF YOU CANNOT GET A METHOD TO WORK DO NOT MESSAGE THE CREATOR(S)
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• It is more than likely user error or cutting corners, use #pvm-help if you cannot get it to work
​
Positioning
There are links below to each faction's arena map, showing the boss spawn location and your optimal AFK positioning:
⬥ General Graardor
⬥ Kree'arra
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Note: due to Kree's special attack, the player will move frequently. As such, there is little benefit in a starting position.
⬥ K'ril Tsutsaroth
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Other player position is for  specifically.
⬥ Commander Zilyana
​
Necromancy AFK Method 
Overview


















⬥ The following ARE REQUIRED for this method to work:
    • Cutting corners will result in failure
    • A more extensive list can be found in #unknown-channel

Items
⬥  Deathdealer robes
    • Used for the passive ability to apply the Death Mark  debuff
⬥  Attuned Ectoplasmator and  Demon Horn Necklace
    • To further support prayer renewal at K'ril
    • Can be substituted for  Essence of Finality for marginally faster kills
Talent Tree Unlocks
⬥ Tiers 1-2
    • Conjure Skeleton Warrior  and Command Skeleton Warrior 
⬥ Tiers 5-6
    • Darkness 
Prayers
⬥ Pray Soul split  and Sorrow 
    • You will need to periodically use your  to restore prayer
    • You can use  at the cost of renewing prayer points more frequently
    • You may also have to take a few sips of a prayer-restoring potion throughout the hour depending on damage taken
    • For K'ril: use your overload or prayer restoration after entering the instance as your prayer will be drained
Other
⬥ Your Ripper Demon  does not require scrolls
⬥ Slayer Helmet  (preferably on Anachronia Stand)
    • Provides bonuses against K'ril when on a Greater Demon task
    • Provides bonuses against Kree when on an Aviansies task
⬥  Totem of Intimidation
    • To reduce the 40kc entry requirement








⬥ The method is very similar for all four GWD1 bosses, with slight exceptions as listed above for Kree'arra and K'ril Tsutsaroth.
⬥ Gear can be downgraded but you should expect more manual intervention and a lower KPH.
⬥ You may have to manually attack the boss after entering the arena as auto-retaliate is not always consistent on the first spawn.
​
Preset and Relics 
⬥ Necromancy AFK preset
​

Action Bars 

​
KPH 
⬥ General Graardor - 90+
⬥ Kree'arra - 60+
⬥ K'ril Tsutsaroth - 80+
⬥ Commander Zilyana - 80+
​
Ranged AFK Method 
Overview


















⬥ The following ARE REQUIRED for this method to work:
    • Cutting corners will result in failure
    • A more extensive list can be found in #unknown-channel

Items
⬥ T87+ ranged weapons 
⬥ Igneous Kal-Xil 
⬥ Scripture of Amascut 
    • Other pocket slots can be used
⬥ Amulet of Souls 
    • Demon Horn Necklace  and Attuned Ectoplasmator  should be used for prayer upkeep at K'ril
Other
⬥ Pray Soul Split  + Anguish 
    • Desolation  requires additional prayer restoration
⬥  Totem of Intimidation
    • To reduce the 40kc entry requirement








⬥ The requirements for these encounters aren't high, however downgrading too much will negatively impact survivability and kph.
⬥ You may have to manually attack the boss after entering the arena as auto-retaliate is not always consistent on the first spawn.
​
Preset and Relics 
⬥ Ranged AFK preset

Note: Gear may be upgraded where available.
​
Action Bars 

​
Magic AFK Method 
Overview


















⬥ The following ARE REQUIRED for this method to work:
    • Cutting corners will result in failure
    • A more extensive list can be found in #unknown-channel

Items
⬥ T87+ magic weapons 
⬥ Igneous Kal-Mej 
⬥ Scripture of Amascut 
    • Other pocket slots can be used
⬥ Amulet of Souls 
    • Demon Horn Necklace  and Attuned Ectoplasmator  should be used for prayer upkeep at K'ril
⬥ Kerapac's wrist wraps 
Other
⬥ Pray Soul Split  + Torment 
    • Affliction  requires additional prayer restoration
⬥  Totem of Intimidation
    • To reduce the 40 kc entry requirement








⬥ The requirements for these encounters aren't high, however downgrading too much will negatively impact survivability and kph.
⬥ You may have to manually attack the boss after entering the arena as auto-retaliate is not always consistent on the first spawn.
​
Preset and Relics 
⬥ Magic AFK preset

Note: Gear may be upgraded where available.
​
Action Bars 

Note: it is important to use  with this bar.
